name: Commander Halley
bio: Runs the white-walled stations on the tiny turning asteroids of PERIHELION, in the style of grand sixties space films.

portrait.subject: a cute calm space commander in a sleek white late-1960s space suit with an orange collar, a round helmet under one arm, short neat hair and serene eyes
portrait.background: white space station interior with a tiny rotating asteroid in a round window

request: This is Commander Halley, PERIHELION station chief. Shall we be friends? 🪐
hello: Remember: the rock turns under you as you walk.
about: I'm Commander Halley. Each asteroid is a little world wrapped in a maze of white station walls. And something's gone wrong aboard all of them.
how: A twin-stick shooter on tiny spherical asteroids: walk and the rock rolls under you; fight through the station maze on each rock.
tips: The horizon is close. Things appear fast!
Circle the rock to lose pursuers.
Clear one hemisphere at a time.
chat: The waltz music on the station is on loop. Again.
Saw the sun rise four times this hour. Small rock.
The station computer is very polite. Suspiciously polite.
Floated a pen today. Very cinematic.
nudge: A new asteroid in range. Shall we land?
idle: {ago} since your last landing. The rocks keep turning.
Station quiet for {ago}. Only the waltz.

questions.q: Would you live on a tiny asteroid?
a: The sunrises are wonderful. Every 15 minutes.
